app.name: ArgueBot
app.tagline: Ideas worth challenging. Conversations worth keeping.
common.refresh.help: Reload the current records from the server
bulk.selectAll: Select every row on this page that can be deleted
bulk.selectAll.none: Nothing on this page can be deleted
bulk.blocked.factory: Factory prompts are read-only and cannot be deleted.
bulk.blocked.protected: This is protected and cannot be deleted.
bulk.blocked.self: You cannot delete your own account.
bulk.blocked.ownTenant: You cannot delete the tenant you are signed in to.
bulk.blocked.questionOpen: Answer or skip this question before deleting it.
bulk.blocked.questionRunning: Its debate is still running. Delete it after the debate finishes.
bulk.deleteMultiple.help: Delete every selected row. You confirm first.
bulk.title: Delete multiple
bulk.confirm: {count, plural, one {Delete this item?} other {Delete these # items?}}
bulk.partial: {deleted} deleted. {failed, plural, one {1 could not be deleted and is still selected:} other {# could not be deleted and are still selected:}}
bulk.activeRun: A debate is still running. Stop it, or delete this conversation on its own to stop and delete it.
common.pageSize.help: Choose how many matching records appear on each page
common.jump.help: Enter a page number within the matching results
common.search.help: Search the full server history, not only this page
home.title: Your thinking, in progress
home.description: Start a debate, return to a thread, or see what your participants can do.
home.recent: Pick up where you left off
home.empty: Your first conversation starts with a good question.
home.empty.help: Configure at least two participants and an orchestrator, then start a debate.
home.new.help: Create a persistent thread for a question or decision
home.configuration.help: Add at least two agents before starting a debate: Claude Code, Codex or another CLI program, or a model on an HTTP endpoint
home.notice: Conversation history is persistent. Agreement records what agents declared; it does not establish factual correctness.
conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: Questions, arguments, decisions, and everything that followed.
conversations.new.help: Create a saved thread without starting any model or agent process
conversations.archived.help: Switch between active and archived conversation history
conversations.open.help: Read this conversation and its debate history.
conversations.rename.help: Update the title while keeping messages and run history
conversations.stop.help: Stop this conversation's unfinished debate. Partial answers stay in history.
conversations.stop.title: Stop debate
conversations.stop.confirm: Stop the debate in “{title}”? Current state: {state}. Partial answers stay in history, and external work an agent already started may have happened.
conversations.stop.pending: The stop request is accepted, but the debate is still stopping. Try again in a moment.
conversations.delete.blocked: This conversation has an unfinished debate ({state}). Stop it first, or stop and delete in one step.
conversations.stopAndDelete.help: Stop the unfinished debate, wait for it to finish stopping, then permanently delete the conversation.
conversations.titleField.help: The short name shown in the conversation list and at the top of the workspace.
conversations.openingQuestion.help: The question a debate in this conversation starts from. Leave it blank to use the title. You can still change it when you start the debate.
conversations.pin.help: Keep this conversation near the top of the list
conversations.archive.help: Move this conversation out of the active list; history remains available
conversations.delete.help: Permanently remove this conversation after all runs are stopped
conversations.delete.confirm: Delete this conversation and its messages? This cannot be undone. Active or paused runs must be stopped first.
conversations.export.help: Download the complete selected conversation as a Markdown transcript
conversations.json.help: Inspect the conversation record without exposing stored secrets
debate.title: Debate workspace
debate.new.help: Start a new bounded debate inside this conversation, preserving earlier history
debate.question: Debate question
debate.question.help: What the agents debate. It starts as the conversation's opening question and is frozen once the debate begins.
debate.participants.help: Choose at least two agents within the service limit. Each carries its own sign-in: a stored secret, the login on the service machine, or its endpoint's authentication. Review their opening order below. Every seat must agree on the same final proposal.
debate.rounds.help: Each participant speaks once per round. Allowed range: one to fifty.
debate.seconds.help: Time for moderator input between turns. Typing can hold the countdown.
debate.start.help: Freeze the selected runner configurations and start service-owned execution
debate.pause.help: Let the current speaker finish, then pause; pause immediately between turns
debate.resume.help: Explicitly continue a paused or interrupted debate
debate.interrupt.help: Stop the current response and pause with its partial text preserved
debate.stop.help: Stop the active run; its conversation and messages remain saved
debate.extend.help: Increase the limit by two rounds, up to fifty total
debate.status.help: Current durable run state from the service
debate.context: This run includes prior completed conversation messages; runner settings are frozen for its lifetime.
composer.label: Your message
composer.label.help: Write a note for all participants or a private directive to the selected participant. Enter sends; Shift+Enter inserts a newline.
composer.placeholder: Add a note, challenge an assumption, ask what comes next…
composer.send.help: Save this message to the conversation and make it available according to its visibility
composer.mode.help: Notes are public to participants; directives are visible only in their target participant context
composer.recipient.help: Choose the participant snapshot from this run that should receive the directive
composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a newline · Closing the page leaves background runs running
participants.title: Participants
participants.description: Agents take seats in debates or act as the orchestrator. A CLI agent runs a program such as Claude Code or Codex, optionally signed in with a stored secret; a model agent runs a reusable model on an HTTP endpoint. Either can carry role instructions.
participants.add.help: Configure a runner without launching it or spending provider quota
participants.pageDescription: Set up the agents that debate, the HTTP endpoints and models they can run on, and the secrets that sign them in.
participants.tab.agents.help: The seats in a debate. Each agent runs a CLI program or a reusable HTTP model and can carry role instructions and a stored secret.
catalog.intro.models: A model is a model ID on an HTTP endpoint, with its context budget and generation settings. Agents and the orchestrator can run on it. Command-line programs are agents. Changes apply to new runs.
catalog.intro.endpoints: An endpoint is an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible server. Add authentication bindings that use stored secrets for hosted APIs.
catalog.intro.credentials: Secrets are encrypted on the service. Lists never include values; use Reveal in a row's Actions menu to see one. Agents and endpoints refer to them by name.
catalog.empty.models: No models yet. Add an endpoint first, then add a model that uses it.
catalog.empty.endpoints: No endpoints yet. Add one for each Ollama or OpenAI-compatible server.
catalog.empty.credentials: No secrets yet. Add one to sign in a CLI agent or authenticate an endpoint.
catalog.dockerNote: Running ArgueBot in Docker or as another user? The container has no Claude Code or Codex login, so add a secret here and select it on the agent.
catalog.authAddFirst: No HTTP secrets yet. Add a bearer token, header or query secret on the Secrets tab, then pick it here.
catalog.secretValue.json.help: Paste the whole auth.json document. It is encrypted on the service and shown again only through Reveal.
catalog.secretReady: {count, plural, one {# character ready to save.} other {# characters ready to save.}}
credential.guide.title: How to get this secret
credential.guide.shell.mac: Run these commands in Terminal (zsh or bash).
credential.guide.shell.linux: Run these commands in a terminal (bash or zsh).
credential.guide.claude_oauth.1: On a computer with Claude Code installed, run this command and finish signing in with your Claude subscription:
credential.guide.claude_oauth.2: Copy the long-lived token it prints. Treat it like a password.
credential.guide.claude_oauth.3: Paste it below, then choose this secret on a Claude Code agent. ArgueBot passes it to Claude Code as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`.
credential.guide.codex_auth_json.1: Create a Codex login just for ArgueBot. This creates its folder and signs in:
credential.guide.codex_auth_json.1b: To use an OpenAI API key instead of a ChatGPT sign-in, run this with `OPENAI_API_KEY` set:
credential.guide.codex_auth_json.2.mac: Choose `~/.codex-arguebot/auth.json` below. The folder is hidden; in the file picker press Cmd+Shift+. to show it. Or copy the file's contents with this command and paste them:
credential.guide.codex_auth_json.2.linux: Choose `~/.codex-arguebot/auth.json` below. The folder is hidden; in most file pickers press Ctrl+H to show it. Or copy the file's contents with this command (it needs `xclip`; on Wayland use `wl-copy < ~/.codex-arguebot/auth.json`) and paste them:
credential.guide.codex_auth_json.2.windo: Choose `auth.json` in the `.codex-arguebot` folder of your user profile (for example `C:\Users\you\.codex-arguebot\auth.json`) below. Or copy the file's contents with this command and paste them:
credential.guide.codex_auth_json.3: Pick this secret on a Codex agent. ArgueBot refreshes the login from now on, so do not use that copy anywhere else.
credential.guide.token.1: Create an API key in your provider's console, for example OpenAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot (Kimi), Alibaba Cloud (Qwen) or OpenRouter.
credential.guide.token.3: On the HTTP Endpoints tab, edit the endpoint and add an authentication binding (usually Bearer token) that uses this secret. Local Ollama needs none.
participants.empty: No agents yet. Add two to start a debate.
profile.name: Display name
profile.name.help: How this participant appears in messages and the speaking order
profile.kind.help: Choose Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Mux to fill the executable and complete unattended arguments. Another program is configured manually; REST uses a model API.
profile.provider.help: Choose the actual protocol supported by the executable or endpoint
profile.executable.help: Enter only the program name, such as claude or codex, or its full path on the service machine. Do not add flags or quote the path. Put flags in the argument rows below.
profile.arguments: Arguments (one flag or value per row)
profile.arguments.help: Selecting Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Mux fills in the executable and complete arguments. Claude Code includes --dangerously-skip-permissions; Codex and Mux include --yolo, so debate turns run without permission prompts. You can edit each argument separately. Custom arguments replace the complete default list; no rows restores the selected program's defaults when saved. Generic CLI requires your own configuration. Do not add shell quotes.
profile.directory.help: Existing directory on the service machine for CLI agents and REST local tools. Empty uses the service working directory. Tools can change files as the service account.
profile.endpoint.help: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS endpoint for the selected provider, without embedded credentials
profile.model.help: Exact model name accepted by the endpoint; this is separate from the display name
profile.secret.help: Name of the environment variable on the server containing the provider secret. Enter the variable name, never the API key.
profile.timeout.help: Maximum generation time, from one to 3600 seconds
profile.maxOutput.help: Maximum response capture, from 1024 bytes to 67108864 bytes (64 MiB default); excess output fails visibly
profile.enabled.help: Allow this profile to be selected for new runs
profile.capability: REST participants can read and write local files, list directories and run programs through ArgueBot tools. Tools run on the service machine as its account, using this working directory (or the service directory if empty). Calls and results appear in conversation history. CLI agents use their program's own tools.
settings.title: Service settings
settings.description: Effective settings for the machine that owns this workspace.
settings.help: Service bootstrap settings are separate from database-backed runner profiles. Environment secret values are never shown.
settings.readonly: Settings editing and restart controls are being integrated with the typed settings API.
state.question: Follow-up question
profile.delete.help: Remove this reusable profile. Existing run snapshots and messages remain unchanged.
profile.delete.confirm: Delete this participant profile? Saved run history is preserved.
settings.port.help: Listener port, from 1 to 65535. Changing it requires restart and reconnecting to the new URL.
settings.concurrent.help: Maximum simultaneous conversation workers, from one to 64. Requires restart.
settings.database.help: Select the persistence provider. Changing providers requires a deliberate data migration and restart; this does not copy history.
settings.connectionEnv.help: Server environment variable containing the database connection string. Empty uses the configured local SQLite default. Never enter a password here.
settings.cli: Allow local execution (CLI agents and REST tools)
settings.cli.help: Permit CLI agents and REST model tools to access files and run programs on the service machine. Turning this off disables both after restart; REST chat remains available.
settings.overridden: The listener port is overridden by a launch flag; that flag continues to win after restart.
settings.restartFields: These bootstrap fields require restart. Save changes first, then restart when your runs can be interrupted.
settings.save.help: Validate and atomically save the allowlisted nonsecret service settings
settings.restart.help: Drain workers, preserve interrupted checkpoints, then reload the saved service settings
settings.restart.confirm: Restart the server? Active responses will be interrupted and runs remain recoverable. If you changed the port, open the new server URL.
settings.restartTimeout: The server has not returned at this URL. If you changed its port, reconnect using the new URL; otherwise inspect the service log.
settings.restarting: Restarting the service and waiting for it to become reachable…
settings.restartRequired: Saved settings require a restart before they take effect.
history.title: Request History
history.description: Inspect captured requests. Secrets, passwords, tokens and other sensitive fields are redacted before storage, and sign-in, token and secret requests keep no bodies.
history.inspect.help: View request metadata, redacted headers and captured body prefixes.
history.truncated: The captured body was truncated at the configured byte limit.
history.copy.help: Copy this redacted request record as JSON.
history.path.help: Filter requests by a literal path fragment.
history.status.help: Filter requests by an HTTP status code from 100 to 599.
history.delete.confirm: Delete this captured request and its headers? This cannot be undone.
history.chart.help: Request counts by time. Hover over a bucket for details, or focus the chart and use Left and Right arrow keys. Home and End select the first and last buckets; Escape dismisses details.
explorer.title: API Explorer
explorer.description: Explore the service contract and execute requests against this workspace.
explorer.search.help: Filter operations by method, path or description.
explorer.parameter.help: Enter the value for this request parameter.
explorer.body.help: Edit a valid JSON request body. Examples may require replacing IDs.
explorer.auth: Requests run against this service. No account or authentication is required.
explorer.execute.help: Send the selected request to this service.
explorer.confirm.help: This request can change stored data or service state. Check the path, IDs and body before executing.
profile.argument.help: One flag or value. Spaces inside this row stay part of the same value. An empty row is passed as an empty argument.
profile.argument.add.help: Append a literal argument to the process argument list.
profile.argument.remove.help: Remove this argument from the process argument list.
explorer.invalidPath: Choose a service API path on this origin.
settings.streamCharacters.help: Commit accumulated text at this threshold, from one through 65536 characters. A timer also flushes smaller batches. Applies after restart.
settings.streamInterval.help: Flush accumulated text even if the runner stops emitting. Ten through 5000 milliseconds, plus storage time. Applies after restart.
settings.contextCharacters.help: Maximum UTF-16 characters in the exact system prompt plus selected message content. Over-budget work pauses before invocation and retains the full transcript. Takes effect after restart.
settings.contextMessages.help: Maximum messages selected for one generation attempt. The service pauses before invoking a model if exceeded; it never silently drops history. Takes effect after restart.
attempts.title: Generation attempts
attempts.title.help: Inspect each external invocation and explicit retry, with its immutable participant, prompt digest and selected source messages.
attempts.description: An interrupted invocation may have performed external work. Resuming is an explicit retry. Context limits are character/message bounds, not model token estimates.
attempts.context.help: Exact ordered message identifiers selected at acceptance. Completed history and eligible private directives are included; interrupted answers and other recipients are excluded.
attempts.empty: No generation-attempt records are available for this run.
attempts.question: Frozen original question
attempts.inspect.help: View this attempt’s immutable provenance and source-message previews.
attempts.pending: No source messages were selected; the system prompt still applies.
attempts.missing: Source message is unavailable in the loaded transcript.
attempts.run.help: Choose a current or historical run. Its original question and participant snapshots remain unchanged by later edits.
debate.outcome.help: The durable reason for completion or pause. Inspect generation attempts for individual failures and selected source context.
outcome.consensus: An agent declared consensus under the legacy rule. It is a recorded claim, not verified agreement.
outcome.v2.consensus: Unanimous: every active seat agreed to the same proposal.
outcome.v2.max_rounds: Round limit reached without unanimous agreement. Recorded dissent is kept with each proposal.
outcome.interrupted: Interrupted work is paused. Resuming explicitly retries the unfinished turn.
outcome.context_budget_exceeded: Context exceeds service limits. Increase the context limits in Settings before resuming.
outcome.uncertain_attempt: An unfinished attempt requires service restart and reconciliation before retrying.
outcome.provider_error: The provider rejected generation. Inspect the attempt and endpoint configuration before retrying.
outcome.stream_persistence_failed: The answer could not be durably checkpointed. Check storage before retrying.
outcome.execution_error: Execution paused after an internal error. Inspect service diagnostics before retrying.
messages.changed: History changed while reading it. Retry with a fresh snapshot.
messages.latest.help: Return to the live tail and capture the newest message membership. Older-page membership stays fixed until you refresh it.
messages.full.help: Load this complete message explicitly. History pages show bounded previews; exports include full content.
messages.loadSource.help: Fetch the complete owned source message without loading other history.
settings.historyPreview.help: Maximum Unicode code points per message preview, 128 through 16384. Full text remains available explicitly. Takes effect after restart.
messages.newer.help: New messages arrived beyond your captured page. Open the latest page to see them; older history stays in place.
messages.preview: Preview of {bytes, number} stored UTF-8 bytes
messages.preview.help: This page shows a bounded preview. Read full message loads the complete stored text. The byte count can grow while generation continues.
messages.snapshot: Full stored text at the time of this read. Refresh to load further content if generation is still running.
events.refresh: Replay needs a fresh conversation snapshot before reconnecting.
settings.replay.help: Bound transport replay history independently of permanent transcripts and audit events. Changes take effect after restart.
settings.eventEnabled.help: Prune replay-event prefixes in the background. Transcript and audit history remain available; the latest event is retained to preserve sequence order.
settings.eventDays.help: Discard replay prefixes through expired events, while retaining the latest event for monotonic sequencing.
settings.eventCount.help: Bound each conversation’s replay window. Clients with expired cursors reload snapshots before reconnecting.
settings.eventInterval.help: Delay between background retention passes, five through 3600 seconds.
settings.eventBatch.help: Bound metadata loaded per maintenance batch, one through one thousand conversations.
settings.eventPage.help: Maximum events returned per default replay batch, one through one thousand.
settings.tls.help: Provision keys/listener.pfx in this application home before enabling. Restart to apply, then use the HTTPS address.
settings.tlsPasswordEnv.help: Optional variable on the service machine containing the PFX password. Enter the variable name, never the password.
outcome.authorization_revoked: Execution was disabled for this workspace. Re-enable the required execution setting before explicitly resuming.
outcome.authorization_unavailable: Execution paused because the service could not confirm its execution settings. Inspect service diagnostics before retrying.
profile.executable.commandError: This looks like a command with flags. Enter only the program name here, such as claude. Put each flag or value in a separate argument row below.
profile.snapshots.help: Changes apply to new debates. Existing debates keep the agent settings they started with. After fixing an agent, stop the old debate and start a new one.
outcome.Win32Exception: The agent program could not start. In Participants, check its executable name or path and working directory. The executable field takes the program only; put flags in separate argument rows. After fixing it, start a new debate: Resume uses the old saved settings.
outcome.tool_limit: The model reached the local tool call limit. Review its tool activity before continuing.
outcome.tools_disabled: Local tools are disabled in service settings. Enable local execution to use them.
outcome.duplicate_tool_call: The provider repeated a tool invocation. ArgueBot stopped before running that operation again.
copy.manual.help: Your browser blocked automatic clipboard access. The complete text is selected below. Press Ctrl+C (Windows/Linux) or Command+C (Mac), or use your device’s Copy action.
copy.unavailable: The complete text could not be loaded. Refresh and try copying again.
common.copy.help: Copy the displayed text to the clipboard.
common.copyId.help: Copy the exact ID to the clipboard.
messages.copy.help: Copy the complete turn text, including content beyond the preview.
conversations.copy.help: Copy the full conversation as Markdown, including earlier pages and full message text.
explorer.operation.help: Choose an HTTP method and API path. Its parameters and request body appear below.
rows.edit: Click or press Enter to edit this object.
rows.open: Open this conversation. Use the Actions menu to rename, pin, archive or delete.
rows.inspect: Click or press Enter to inspect this record.
service.address.help: The machine that owns history and executes configured runners
service.unavailable.help: The ArgueBot service is not answering. Start it with go-web, then reconnect.
activity.silence: No answer text change observed for {seconds, number}s in this view. Tool activity is not shown here.
activity.deadline: Elapsed: {elapsed, number}s / per-turn limit: {timeout, number}s. This timer is not an agent heartbeat. Resume retains this limit.
activity.waiting: Waiting for agent output. Some agents stay silent while thinking or using tools.
activity.pausing: Pause requested. Waiting for the current turn to finish.
activity.connectionHelp: Live updates are unavailable. Agent progress cannot currently be confirmed.
messages.failedHelp: The agent did not complete this response. Inspect the generation attempt for details.
panel.title: Debate panel
panel.unanimous: Consensus requires explicit agreement from every active agent on the same proposal.
panel.setupHelp: Choose 2 through {maximum} seats. ArgueBot uses the orchestrator for questions and summaries; it does not vote.
panel.changeHelp: Changes apply between invocations and require fresh agreement. Earlier answers and dissent remain in history.
panel.noProposal: After the panel responds, ArgueBot will propose an answer for each agent to evaluate.
position.superseded.help: This seat voted again on the same proposal after new context reached it. Only its latest vote counts.
phase.question: Orchestrator question
memory.title: Context summaries and sources
memory.help: Summaries help the panel work within its context limit. Original turns remain authoritative. Inspect the sources if a summary misses or misstates something.
memory.pauseHelp: Pause the debate before changing its derived context.
memory.empty: No summaries yet. ArgueBot compacts context when it needs more room.
memory.context.help: Your answer is shared with the panel and retained as pinned context.
catalog.endpoints.help: HTTP connections to Ollama or OpenAI-compatible servers, with their authentication bindings.
catalog.models.help: A model on an HTTP endpoint, with its context budget, output limits and capabilities.
catalog.credentials.help: Encrypted secrets for agents and endpoints. Values appear only when you choose Reveal.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.name.help: A distinct display name used in selectors and run snapshots.
catalog.protocol.help: Native Ollama chat or OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions. Responses API support is separate.
catalog.baseUrl.help: Server root such as http://127.0.0.1:11434. Never include secrets in the URL; use a binding.
catalog.timeoutSeconds.help: How long one request may run before it fails with a timeout.
catalog.enabled.help: Disabled records cannot be chosen for new runs. Existing runs keep their snapshots.
catalog.authBindings.help: Headers or query parameters sent with every request to this endpoint, such as a bearer token and a routing header.
catalog.bindingKind.help: Bearer token, API-key header, custom header, or query-string parameter.
catalog.bindingName.help: The exact header or query parameter name, for example x-api-key.
catalog.credentialId.help: The stored secret that signs this in. Manage secrets on the Secrets tab.
catalog.environmentVariable.help: Enter the variable name on the service, never its value.
catalog.staticValue.help: Use only nonsecret routing metadata here. Store authentication values as secrets.
catalog.addBinding.help: Add another header or query binding. Duplicate names are rejected.
catalog.provider.help: Choose a preset so ArgueBot parses this program's output correctly.
catalog.executable.help: Program name or path only. Put flags in the argument rows.
catalog.workingDirectory.help: Directory the program runs in. It is not a sandbox; local tools can reach the rest of the machine.
catalog.endpointId.help: The HTTP endpoint that serves this model.
catalog.model.help: The model identifier the provider expects, for example deepseek-r1:14b. Use Discover models to list them.
catalog.contextMaxCharacters.help: Conservative character budget, 8192 through 16777216. The service also enforces its own limit.
catalog.supportsTools.help: Declared capability. Run a model check to confirm tool calls actually work.
catalog.kind.help: What the secret is for. A Claude Code token or Codex login signs in a CLI agent. A bearer token, header or query parameter authenticates an HTTP endpoint.
catalog.secretValue.help: Paste the value once. It is encrypted on the service and shown again only through Reveal.
catalog.secretFile: Or read a local secret file
catalog.secretFile.help: Read the value from a file on this computer instead of pasting it.
catalog.token.help: A bearer token or API key for an HTTP endpoint.
catalog.replace.help: Store a new value for this secret. Leaving the field empty keeps the current value.
catalog.disable.help: Prevent new runs from using this secret. Existing references remain readable.
catalog.reveal.help: Show this secret's decrypted value after you confirm.
catalog.reveal.title: Reveal secret
catalog.reveal.warning: This shows the decrypted secret on screen. Anyone who can see this screen can read it. Request history does not record the value.
catalog.reveal.codex: A Codex login includes the refresh token ArgueBot manages. Using that copy elsewhere can sign ArgueBot out.
catalog.reveal.value.help: The decrypted value. It is cleared when you close this dialog.
catalog.reveal.copy.help: Copy the decrypted value to the clipboard.
catalog.modelProfileId.help: Run on a reusable HTTP model, or configure a CLI program or HTTP settings on this agent.
catalog.inline: None: configure a program or HTTP settings here
catalog.inline.help: Enter command or HTTP settings on this agent instead of selecting a reusable model.
catalog.roleInstructions.help: Describe this participant’s role and priorities. The orchestrator uses its own role instructions.
catalog.authHelp: No bindings means no added authentication. Each row uses exactly one stored secret, environment reference, or nonsecret header value. Multiple rows support gateways with routing headers. A bearer, header or query secret sets the binding type and name itself.
catalog.secretHelp: ArgueBot encrypts values and never includes them in lists, logs, request history or model context. Reveal shows a value on request.
catalog.fileLimit: Choose a secret file no larger than 64 KiB.
settings.maxParticipants.help: Admission limit from 2 through 64. Default 16. Restart the service after changing this setting.
settings.listenAddress.help: Use 127.0.0.1 for native use. Container deployments use 0.0.0.0 inside the container and publish only to host loopback. Restart to apply.
catalog.discoveryHelp: These IDs were advertised by the endpoint. No completion was invoked. Generation, tool support and context capacity remain unverified. Copy an ID into a model configuration or enter one manually.
catalog.noModels: No models advertised. Manual model IDs remain supported.
catalog.discoveryTruncated: Only the first 1,000 distinct model IDs are shown.
policy.title: Execution budgets and orchestrator guidance
policy.help: Limits are fixed when the run starts. Failures and explicit retries consume reservations. The elapsed deadline includes queued and paused time. Start a continuation to choose new limits.
policy.estimateHelp: The input estimate uses initial prompt UTF-8 bytes plus framing allowance. It is not billed tokens and excludes continuation/output accounting. Zero disables this estimated-input limit. Provider prices are not configured, so no currency cap is claimed.
policy.workload: Baseline maximum: {turns} answers, {turns} votes and {orchestration} orchestration calls, before compaction, retries or context changes. Independent budgets still apply.
policy.maxParticipantTurns.help: Counts answers and individual proposal votes, including failed invocations.
policy.maxOrchestrationCalls.help: Counts question selection and proposal synthesis separately from participant turns.
policy.maxCompactionCalls.help: Maximum model invocations used to preserve context.
policy.maxToolCalls.help: Shared across local tools and conversation evidence tools.
policy.maxStepRetries.help: How many times one step is repeated before the debate pauses: correction requests after an invalid question, proposal, vote or summary, and repeats after a rate limit, provider outage, dropped connection, agent exit or turn timeout, waiting 5, 15, 45 seconds and so on. 0 pauses at the first failure. A repeated turn can repeat external work.
policy.maxWallClockSeconds.help: Elapsed time from run creation, including queues and pauses. Retry does not reset it.
policy.maxContextCharacters.help: Upper bound per invocation; the service and model limits also apply.
policy.maxEstimatedInputTokens.help: Initial UTF-8 input estimate only. Set zero to disable this estimate limit.
policy.questionInstructions.help: Describe the evidence gaps and assumptions the orchestrator should probe.
policy.synthesisInstructions.help: Describe the criteria and tradeoffs the proposal should address.
policy.summaryInstructions.help: Describe the constraints, disagreements and source details that memory must retain.
catalog.maxConcurrentInvocations.help: Maximum simultaneous generations across debates using this endpoint. Changes apply when new work requests capacity.
catalog.keyHelp: Rotate the master encryption key and reencrypt stored secrets. Secret values and revisions stay the same. Earlier keys stay available for recovery and older backups until you retire them. Back up the protected secrets directory separately after each change.
catalog.keyRotated: {count} secrets reencrypted. Back up the protected secrets directory.
attempts.noCredentials: No stored secret revisions were recorded for this attempt.
modelCheck.title: Completion and tool checks
modelCheck.help: This explicitly invokes the saved model and may incur provider cost. A tool check can require another completion. Only safe observations are saved; response text is discarded.
modelCheck.declared: Current model revision {revision}. Declared tool support: {tools}. Observations below apply only to their recorded revisions.
modelCheck.tools: Include a harmless tool round trip
modelCheck.tools.help: Ask the model to call one fixed probe and receive its result. This does not modify files or configuration.
modelCheck.empty: No checks recorded. Saving configuration never invokes the model.
memory.noParents: This summary was built directly from original turns.
memory.digest: Original content SHA-256 at summary acceptance
memory.hashHelp: Hashes identify the original content used. They do not establish that a summary is accurate. Inspect original sources to check its claims.
catalog.maxOutputBytes.help: Service capture limit from 1024 bytes to 64 MiB. This is separate from provider token limits.
catalog.generationHelp: Optional provider overrides. Blank token limit uses the transport default of 4096; blank sampling values use provider defaults. Some models reject sampling settings. Use explicit model checks to verify your endpoint. CLI flags belong in the agent's arguments.
catalog.previewHelp: This reads saved configuration only. No endpoint is contacted and no secret is resolved. Both requests use these bindings; all values are redacted. Standard protocol headers are added by the transport.
catalog.maxOutputTokens.help: Optional provider output-token ceiling. Blank uses 4096; this is separate from input context and captured output bytes.
catalog.temperature.help: Optional value from 0 to 2. Leave blank when the model requires its own sampling defaults.
catalog.topP.help: Optional probability from 0 to 1. Leave blank to use the provider default.
catalog.environmentVariables.help: Comma-separated names on the service host, never values. Standard paths, locale, proxy and TLS settings are always passed. Add provider variables such as GEMINI_API_KEY explicitly.
panel.editProposal.help: Revise the proposal the panel is voting on. Every seat votes again on your text.
panel.editProposalHelp: Every active seat votes again on your revision. Votes already cast stay with the original proposal as history and do not count toward the revision. A vote that finishes after you save is not counted.
panel.revisedProposal.help: Up to 32,000 characters. Markdown is supported.
panel.saveRevision.help: Replace the proposal and ask every seat to vote on it.
panel.moderatorRevision.help: You wrote this revision. It replaced the orchestrator's proposal.
panel.replacedProposal.help: A moderator revision replaced this proposal. Its votes are kept for the record and do not count.
debate.fieldError: Fix the highlighted setting before starting.
debate.duplicateNames: Two selected agents share the name {name}. Rename one so votes stay attributable.
attempts.repair.help: The previous reply was not the required structured answer, so ArgueBot asked this agent once to reply again in the required format.
debate.removedSelection: An agent you selected was deleted or disabled, so it was removed from this panel. Review the panel, then start again.
panel.replacedTally: Replaced before voting finished. {count, plural, =0 {No votes were cast on it.} one {# earlier vote is kept for the record and does not count.} other {# earlier votes are kept for the record and do not count.}}
memory.openSource: Open the original source this summary cites
catalog.keySkipped: {count, plural, one {# disabled secret could not be read and was left unchanged.} other {# disabled secrets could not be read and were left unchanged.}} Replace it with a fresh value to include it, or leave it disabled.
catalog.keysRetired: {count, plural, one {# earlier key retired.} other {# earlier keys retired.}} Back up the protected secrets directory now.
catalog.retireKeys.help: Remove earlier keys once every secret uses the active key.
catalog.retireConfirm.help: Remove the earlier keys from the keyring now.
catalog.retireWarning: Retiring {count, plural, one {# earlier key} other {# earlier keys}} means database backups made before the latest rotation can no longer decrypt their secrets. If any current secret still uses an earlier key, this is refused. Select Retire keys permanently to continue.
credential.kind.token: HTTP token (placement set on the endpoint)
catalog.parameterName.http_header.help: The exact HTTP header the value is sent in, for example x-api-key. It cannot change after the secret is saved.
catalog.parameterName.http_query.help: The query string key the value is sent as, for example key. It cannot change after the secret is saved.
catalog.secretValue.parameter.help: The secret value sent in this header or query parameter. It is encrypted on the service and shown again only through Reveal.
credential.guide.http_bearer.1: Create an API key or token in your provider's console, for example OpenAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot (Kimi), Alibaba Cloud (Qwen) or OpenRouter.
credential.guide.http_bearer.2: Paste it below. ArgueBot sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <value>`.
credential.guide.http_bearer.3: On the HTTP Endpoints tab, edit the endpoint, choose Add binding and pick this secret.
credential.guide.http_header.1: Find the header your provider expects, such as `x-api-key` or `api-key`, and create the key in its console.
credential.guide.http_header.2: Enter the header name and paste the key as the value. ArgueBot sends `<name>: <value>` with every request.
credential.guide.http_header.3: On the HTTP Endpoints tab, edit the endpoint, choose Add binding and pick this secret. The binding uses this header name automatically.
credential.guide.http_query.1: Find the query parameter your provider expects, such as `key`, and create the key in its console.
credential.guide.http_query.2: Enter the parameter name and paste the key as the value. ArgueBot appends `?<name>=<value>` to every request URL.
credential.guide.http_query.3: On the HTTP Endpoints tab, edit the endpoint, choose Add binding and pick this secret. Remote endpoints must use HTTPS.
credential.status.refresh_uncertain.help: A Codex token refresh was sent but its result is unknown, so ArgueBot will not reuse the stored refresh token. Sign in again in a dedicated CLI home and replace this auth.json.
panel.show.help: Show proposals, votes, roster, context delivery and memory beside the transcript.
panel.hide.help: Give the transcript the full width. Your choice is remembered in this browser.
explorer.invalidJson: The request body is not valid JSON: {message}
explorer.placeholders: Replace the placeholder values {names} with real identifiers or values before sending. They come from the Postman collection example.
explorer.resetExample.help: Replace the body with the documented example.
outcome.provider_unauthorized: The provider refused the credentials. Check the endpoint's credential, then resume.
outcome.provider_rate_limited: The provider is rate limiting requests. Wait a little, then resume.
outcome.provider_unavailable: The provider failed with a server error. Resume later.
outcome.provider_disconnected: The provider dropped the connection mid-answer. Partial text is kept; resume to retry the turn.
outcome.provider_unreachable: ArgueBot could not connect to the provider. Check the endpoint, then resume.
outcome.refresh_unavailable: The Codex login service was unavailable. The login is unchanged; resume to retry.
outcome.invalid_orchestration_output: A model did not return the required structured answer within the step retry limit. Inspect it, then resume or replace the seat.
outcome.summary_validation_failed: A summary failed validation within the step retry limit. The previous memory is kept; inspect it, then resume or rebuild.
credential.guide.copyCommand.help: Copy this command to the clipboard, then paste it into a terminal.
messages.jump.help: Scroll straight to a turn on this page and expand it.
messages.shown: {count, plural, one {# turn on this page} other {# turns on this page}}
prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.description: The instructions each debate step sends to the orchestrator or agents. Factory defaults are read-only; duplicate one to make an editable copy, then choose it when you create a conversation or start a debate.
prompts.purposeFilter.help: Show prompts for one debate step.
prompts.add.help: Create a prompt for one debate step.
prompts.name: Name
prompts.name.help: Shown when choosing prompts for a conversation or debate.
prompts.factory.help: Built in and read-only. It stays current with each ArgueBot release.
prompts.custom.help: A prompt in this workspace that you can edit or delete.
prompts.duplicate.help: Make an editable copy of this prompt.
prompts.duplicateToEdit.help: Factory prompts are read-only. Make an editable copy instead.
prompts.delete.title: Delete prompt
prompts.delete.confirm: Delete “{name}”? Conversations that use it switch to the factory default. Debates already started keep the copy they began with.
prompts.factoryNotice: This factory default is read-only. Duplicate it to make a copy you can change.
prompts.purposeField.help: Which step uses this prompt. It cannot change after the prompt is created.
prompts.descriptionField.help: A short note about when to choose this prompt.
prompts.body.help: Sent as the instructions for this step. Write placeholders such as '{question}'; the legend lists every one you can use.
prompts.legend.help: Click a parameter to insert it at the cursor. Each one is replaced when the step runs.
prompts.legend.readOnly: Each parameter is replaced when the step runs.
prompts.legend.braces: The conversation itself is sent to the model separately, after these instructions. Write '{{' and '}}' for literal braces.
prompts.problem.unknown: {name} is not a parameter. Use one from the legend, or double the braces for literal text.
prompts.formatWarning: Keep the reply format the factory prompt asks for (for example, “Return only a JSON object with …”). ArgueBot asks for a corrected reply up to the debate's step retry limit, then pauses the debate if the model still cannot follow it.
prompts.purpose.question: Orchestrator question
prompts.picker.title: Debate prompts
prompts.picker.custom: {count, plural, one {# custom prompt} other {# custom prompts}}
prompts.picker.help: Choose the prompt each debate step uses. Manage prompts on the Prompts page.
timeline.view.timeline.help: One line per turn, expandable, with tool calls grouped. Best for following a debate as it runs.
timeline.view.cards.help: Every turn shown in full as a card.
timeline.tools: {count, plural, one {# tool call} other {# tool calls}}
messages.window.help: Read this turn in a wide window with its full text and formatting.
messages.loadingFull: Loading the full message ({bytes, number} UTF-8 bytes)…
messages.fullFailed: Only a preview is shown; the full message could not be loaded. Use Open in window to try again.
timeline.live.noOutput: Working. Nothing is visible yet; the agent may be reading, searching or thinking.
timeline.live.tool: {count, plural, =0 {Using {tool}} one {Using {tool} (# tool call so far)} other {Using {tool} (# tool calls so far)}}
reader.open.help: Open the whole conversation as a full-page document, with rounds, final proposal and votes.
reader.copy.help: Copy the complete transcript as Markdown.
reader.print.help: Print the transcript, or choose Save as PDF in the print dialog.
login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with your email and password, or with a bearer token.
login.token.help: A credential token (abt_...) or the default token. It is kept only for this browser session.
login.tenant.help: Your email and password work in more than one tenant. Choose the one to sign in to.
login.tenantRequired: Your email and password work in several tenants. Choose a tenant, then sign in again.
login.useToken: Sign in with a bearer token instead
login.usePassword: Sign in with email and password instead
login.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
login.defaults.title: Default administrator
account.title: Account
account.description: Your profile, password, bearer tokens and sessions in {tenant}.
account.tenant.help: The tenant you are signed in to. Conversations and configuration are shared within it.
account.role.system: You are a system administrator: you manage every tenant, the service settings and encryption keys.
account.role.tenant: You are a tenant administrator: you manage this tenant's users and audit log.
account.role.member: You are a member of this tenant. You can use and change its conversations and configuration.
account.password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
account.password.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
account.credentialSession: You signed in with a bearer token, which has no session. Sign in with your email and password to manage sessions.
authCredentials.title: Bearer tokens
authCredentials.description: Credentials for scripts, the CLI and other tools. Send a token as Authorization: Bearer. Reveal shows a token again; each reveal is audited.
authCredentials.name: Name
authCredentials.name.help: What the token is for, for example CI or a laptop.
authCredentials.protected.help: The default administrator token cannot be disabled or deleted.
authCredentials.created.title: Copy your new token
authCredentials.created.help: Copy it now and store it like a password. You can reveal it again later from the Actions menu; each reveal is audited.
authCredentials.created.usage: Use it with Authorization: Bearer, with x-token, or with the CLI's --token option or ARGUEBOT_TOKEN.
authCredentials.delete.title: Delete token
authCredentials.delete.confirm: Delete {name}? Anything using it stops working immediately.
authSessions.title: Sessions
authSessions.description: Browsers and tools signed in with your password. Sessions end after 60 minutes without a refresh.
authSessions.signOutThis.help: Use Sign out in the account menu to end this session.
users.title: Users
users.description: People who can sign in to {tenant}. Everyone in a tenant shares its conversations and configuration.
users.tenant.help: System administrators can manage the users of any tenant.
users.name: Name
users.protected.help: The default administrator cannot be deleted, disabled or lose administrator access.
users.password.help: At least 8 characters. Share it with the user, who can change it on their Account page.
users.tenantAdmin.help: Can manage this tenant's users, their tokens and sessions, request history and the audit log.
users.systemAdmin.help: Can manage every tenant, the service settings and encryption keys.
users.active.help: Disabled users cannot sign in, and their sessions and tokens stop working.
users.resetPassword.help: Set a new password for {email}. Their sessions are signed out.
users.manageAccess.help: See and revoke this user's bearer tokens and sessions.
users.delete.title: Delete user
users.delete.confirm: Delete {email}? Their conversations and configuration stay in the tenant. Their tokens and sessions stop working.
tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.description: Each tenant has its own users, conversations and configuration. Nothing is shared between tenants.
tenants.add.next: Next, open the tenant's users and add its first tenant administrator.
tenants.name: Name
tenants.active.help: Users of a disabled tenant cannot sign in, and its sessions and tokens stop working.
tenants.protected.help: The default tenant cannot be deleted or disabled.
tenants.delete.title: Delete tenant
tenants.delete.confirm: Delete {name} and everything in it: users, conversations, agents, secrets and prompts. This cannot be undone.
tenants.delete.type: Type the tenant's name to confirm
audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Sign-ins, sessions, tokens, user changes and every denied request in this tenant.
audit.description.system: Sign-ins, sessions, tokens, identity changes and every denied request in every tenant, including requests without a valid token.
audit.prune.help: Delete audit records older than the age you choose. The deletion itself is recorded.
audit.prune.done: {count, plural, one {# audit record deleted.} other {# audit records deleted.}}
share.action.help: Create a public, time-limited link to this conversation's transcript.
share.title: Share a read-only link
share.description: Anyone with a link can read the transcript of {title} until the link expires or you revoke it. They cannot see secrets, prompts, agent settings or anything else in ArgueBot.
share.expires.help: The link stops working at this time.
share.tools.help: Show agents' tool calls and results, such as files they read. Leave this off unless readers need them.
share.created.help: Copy it now. It works until {date}. You can show it again from the list below while it is active.
authCredentials.reveal.help: Show this token again. Each reveal is recorded in the audit log.
authCredentials.reveal.title: Reveal token
authCredentials.reveal.confirm: Show the token for {name}? Anyone who sees it can act as this user. The reveal is recorded in the audit log.
authCredentials.revealed.title: Bearer token
authCredentials.revealed.help: The token for {name}. Handle it like a password.
share.show.help: Show this link again so you can copy it. The reveal is recorded in the audit log.
seat.hostLogin: no secret: uses the service machine's own login
profile.cliModel.help: Passed to the program as --model. Blank uses the program's default model.
profile.cliModel.placeholder.help: Put a literal {model} argument where this program expects the model name. Blank uses the program's default.
profile.credential.help: Select a stored secret when running in Docker or to override the credentials used by default by the agent.
profile.credential.none: None: use the login on the service machine
profile.credential.addFirst: To use one, add a {kind} on the Secrets tab first.
profile.credential.unsupported: This program has no stored secret. Pass its API key through Allowed environment names instead.
agentCheck.title: Agent checks
agentCheck.help: Runs this agent once with its secret, model and arguments, exactly as a debate seat would. This can cost money. Only safe observations are saved; response text is discarded.
resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Named markdown documents your agents can read during a debate. Point an agent at one in a prompt or role instruction, for example "if you need to know more about billing, call read_resource with name billing", and it reads the resource only when it needs it. Debates set whether agents can only read resources or also write them.
resources.search.help: Find resources by name, title or description.
resources.import.help: Import .md files. Front matter between --- lines can set name, title, description, tags and locked; otherwise the file name becomes the resource name. You can also drop files on this toolbar.
resources.name: Name
resources.name.help: Agents pass this to read_resource. Use letters, digits, '-', '_', '.' and '/', for example billing or team/conventions. Stored in lowercase.
resources.titleField.help: Optional display title, up to 200 characters.
resources.descriptionField.help: One line that tells agents what the resource is for. list_resources shows it.
resources.tagsField.help: Comma-separated, up to 16. Debates can limit their agents to resources with given tags.
resources.locked.help: Agents can read a locked resource but never change it. You can still edit it.
resources.agent.help: An agent wrote the latest revision. Its text carries into later debates, so review it.
resources.user.help: A user wrote the latest revision.
resources.empty: No resources yet. Add one, or import markdown files.
resources.nameInvalid: Use 1 to 128 characters: letters, digits, '-', '_', '.' and '/'. Start with a letter or digit, and do not use empty, '.' or '..' segments.
resources.conflict: Someone else changed this resource since you opened it, so your change was not saved. Reload the latest revision, then reapply your change. Your text is kept below.
resources.export.help: Download this resource as a markdown file with front matter.
resources.diffTitle: Changes from revision {revision} to the current revision {current}
resources.diff: Line changes: - removed since this revision, + added since
resources.agentRevision: Written by the agent {name} in run {run}.
resources.revert.help: Save this revision's title, description, tags and text as a new revision. The name and lock stay as they are.
resources.importConflict.title: Replace existing resources?
resources.importConflict.help: Replace saves the imported text as a new revision of each existing resource. Its history is kept.
resources.delete.title: Delete resource
resources.delete.confirm: Delete {name} and its history? Debates that refer to it will no longer find it.
policy.resources.help: Which of the tenant's resources this debate's agents can use. Leave names and tags empty to allow every resource.
policy.resourceAccess.help: Read offers list_resources, search_resources and read_resource. Read and write also lets agents create, update, edit and append to unlocked resources.
policy.resourceNames.help: Comma-separated names. Resources the debate's agents create stay visible to them.
policy.maxResourceWritesPerTurn.help: Creates, updates, edits and appends one agent turn may make.
policy.maxResourceWriteBytesPerTurn.help: UTF-8 bytes of resource text one agent turn may write.
policy.maxResourcesCreated.help: Total new resources this debate's agents may create.
account.notifications.help: Show a desktop notification in this browser when an agent asks you a question while ArgueBot is in a background tab. The choice applies only to this browser.
account.notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support desktop notifications.
account.notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser's settings. Allow them there to turn this on.
home.waiting: {count, plural, one {# question is waiting for you} other {# questions are waiting for you}}
policy.questions.help: Agents can stop mid-turn to ask you a question and wait for the answer. You answer in a dialog; the debate continues by itself unless you choose otherwise.
policy.userQuestions.help: Every agent, only the orchestrator, or nobody.
policy.intake.help: Before round 1, let the orchestrator ask about a vague question.
policy.intake.ask_if_needed: Ask about a vague question first
policy.resumeOnAnswer.pause: Stay paused until I press Resume
policy.questionHoldSeconds.help: How long an agent keeps its turn open for your answer, 0 through 1800. After that its turn ends and picks up again when you answer.
policy.questionExpirySeconds.help: An unanswered question is treated as skipped after this many seconds. 0 never expires.
policy.maxQuestionRequestsPerTurn.help: Most requests one agent turn may make, 0 through 4.
policy.maxQuestionRequestsPerRun.help: Most requests the whole debate may make, 0 through 200.
policy.maxIntakeQuestions.help: Most questions in the opening request, 1 through 4.
questions.title: Questions
questions.description: Questions agents asked you during debates. Open questions come first. Choose one to answer it in a dialog.
questions.view.help: Show the question, its options and any answer without answering it.
questions.delete.help: Delete this question. Its answer stays in the conversation.
questions.secretNotice: Do not paste passwords, tokens or keys into answers. ArgueBot never needs them.
questions.credentialWarning: This looks like a request for a password, token or key. ArgueBot never needs secrets in answers; skip the question or describe what you can share instead.
questions.resolvedElsewhere: Someone else resolved this question first. Your answer was not sent.
questions.later.help: End the agent's waiting turn now. The debate picks up this step again once you answer.
questions.skip.help: Tell the agent no answer is available. It continues on stated assumptions.
questions.skipHelp: The agent is told you did not answer and continues on stated assumptions. You can add a note, for example what to assume.
questions.answer.help: Open the question in a dialog.
questions.open.help: Open this question in a dialog to answer or review it.
questions.waiting: {count, plural, one {{name} is waiting for your answer.} other {{name} and others are waiting for # answers.}}
questions.notification.title: An agent has a question
questions.notification.body: {name} is waiting for your answer in ArgueBot.
questions.badge: {count, plural, one {# open question} other {# open questions}}
questions.indicator.help: {count, plural, one {Answer the question waiting for you.} other {Answer the newest of # questions waiting for you.}}
questions.live.help: The list and badges check for changes every five seconds.
questions.column.question: Question
questions.showing: Showing {from} to {to} of {total} questions. Page {page} of {pages}.
questions.emptyOpen: No questions are waiting for you. When an agent needs your input during a debate, its question appears here and opens in a dialog.
questions.error.summary: {count, plural, one {Fix # answer before sending.} other {Fix # answers before sending.}}
questions.error.required: Answer this question, or skip the whole request.
questions.error.other: Describe your Other answer, or clear Other.
